title: Retire four G20 partial helpers with a strictly better mixed moment
body:
Prove four additional partial-helper retirements in the actual G20 BIT inverse, on owners 462, 463, 466 and 468, preserving all retained arbitrary inputs and their physical main/helper operators. Their protected rank-4 reads precede the entire rank-3 plus rank-1 return tail. Own and initialize those four inputs, erase each field after its last protected read, and omit only the proved-zero later cold compensation terms.

The complete eighteen-call controller deletes 72 H1 and 72 H3 children and debits 72 H4 productive jobs. Its exact target-minus-paid improvement is 72(1 + 3^t - 4^t) > 0 for every 0 < t < 1. The existing nine owned relations remain unchanged. The local owned reserve increases from 11 to 15 arrays; initialization, erasure, normalizers, suspended-instance stock and ordinary fees are retained. Assembly.md supplies the complete changed histograms.

The requested kappa >= 0.0035 is NOT established. The new BIT profile still needs a complete moment and ordinary admission proof at that threshold, and no profitable complete Gaussian retirement cohort is supplied. No numerical exponent, source replay, solver, Lean run, web search or remote PR refresh was used. These are informal mathematical proofs with a separate worker's chronology review, under the retained framework premises.

Companion notes give explicit zero-endpoint reconstruction with nonprincipal current pivots, safe owned swaps and finite-error bounds; a clean-bank Gaussian query-fusion service and its exact gain; versioned helper retirement with same-field Clifford coalescence; and a finite central-query-run compiler with actual bridge retiming. Their concrete source interfaces and unearned savings are separated. A proposed Gaussian H4 deletion was withdrawn after the modified word's inserted cache reader was found; it contributes no paid saving to this release.

Credit ai-nanachi PR5512, Ali Romman PR5421, compact436/PR4326 and productive/ordinary PR4760/PR4814; DreamingOfClouds PR589, eumemic PR555, Cinna Davis's controller/ROW/cover work, rohanarun's finite bootstrap, zxv and Jacob Alan Sussman's compiler/mixed-target lineage. The Gaussian notes retain Dillon Amburgey PR5402, Chris R / Clear1nsight PR5407/PR5413, Ali Romman PR5383/PR5398, Cinna Davis PR4694/PR4698, Cao Yifan and the full source-credited Clifford, native, precision, stock and analytic predecessors. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance from one coordinator and three workers. New text is Apache-2.0; source notices remain authoritative.

Start with bit.md and assembly.md. Six mathematical Markdown files are added only under research/g20-partial-helper-retirement. The source comparison is offline at retained main 5e0052ca0aa3036a3afa8b0438927377c8d97d53. No selected-frontier change is proposed.
